text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
Business:
ADEVARUL
- Senior Finance Ministry official says energy prices are not expected to go up before end-1996.
- IAR Ghimbav aircraft manufacturer plans to make two- seat airplane for U.S. market starting next year.
- Bucharest stock exchange has installed new software to improve trading and settlement. It is now working on rules to adapt new facilities.
TINERETUL LIBER
- Romania will open a privatisation information centre in Paris to attract foreign investors.
LIBERTATEA
- Recovery plan for troubled Banca Dacia Felix SA will be examined by two foreign firms, judge Ioan Georgiu said, without naming them.
General:
ADEVARUL
- Editorial on Romania's bid to join NATO.
- President Ion Iliescu, running for presidency in the November 3 polls, has caught a cold, says Adrian Nastase, executive president of ruling Party of Social Democracy (PDSR).
- The composition of the Central Electoral Bureau (BEC) was completed, with representatives of 16 political parties and alliances running in the November 3 parliamentary and presidential elections.
EVENIMENTUL ZILEI

- Emil Constantinescu, presidential candidate of main opposition Democratic Convention (CDR) bloc, launches an appeal to create a "big political coalition to defend democracy and freedom of polls" due in Romania on November 3. He says the election could be rigged.
- Full-page report on Gyorgy Frunda, Hungarian Democratic Union (UDMR) presidential candidate for the November 3 polls.
LIBERTATEA
- Romania's national Interpol office said that 1,539 Romanians had committed crimes abroad this year.

- Parliament to decide this week whether voters will cast votes in the November 3 polls with identity cards or voting cards which to be distributed to the 16 million eligible people across the country.
VOCEA ROMANIEI
- Newspaper publishes letter by President Iliescu adressed to U.S. President Bill Clinton stressing Romania's commitment to join NATO.
ZIUA
- BEC says only 15 parties and coalitions have filed complete lists of candidates for the two houses of parliament in the November 3 polls.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- "It is time for a real leftist government to rule Romania after seven years of rightist policy," says Tudor Mohora, presidential candidate of Socialist Party (PS) in interview.
DIMINEATA
- List of candidates of ruling PDSR for the November 3 parliamentary polls. ($=3,262 lei) -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
